_comment: Workday tenants for src/discover-workday.js. EMPTY BY DESIGN - add employers you want swept. Find the values in a posting URL: https://<tenant>.wd<wd>.myworkdayjobs.com/<site>/job/... Probe before adding: Workday answers every hostname, so a wrong guess fails silently and queues nothing. Listed employers bypass the big-company and aggregator filters (naming them is the point); the personal blocklist and the salaried-only rule still apply.
